segments.text: About 66 million years ago, the dinosaurs disappeared.
segments.englishExplanation: Dinosaurs disappeared around 66 million years ago.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yaklaşık 66 milyon yıl önce dinozorlar yok oldu.

segments.text: Most scientists believe a huge asteroid hit the earth and changed the climate.
segments.englishExplanation: Many scientists believe a massive asteroid hit Earth and altered the global climate.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bilim insanlarının çoğu dev bir asteroidin dünyaya çarptığına ve iklimi değiştirdiğine inanıyor.

segments.text: But over the years, other ideas have been suggested too.
segments.englishExplanation: However, different ideas have also been proposed over time.
segments.turkishExplanation: Fakat yıllar içinde başka fikirler de öne sürüldü.

segments.text: It is possible that dinosaurs were wiped out by a disease to which they were not
segments.englishExplanation: It is possible that dinosaurs were eliminated by an illness to which they were not...
segments.turkishExplanation: Dinozorların, karşı dirençli olmadıkları bir hastalık yüzünden yok edilmiş olmaları mümkündür.

segments.englishExplanation: ...resistant to or able to defend against.

segments.text: Their bodies had never met this illness before, so they had no resistance to it.
segments.englishExplanation: Because their bodies had never encountered this disease, they lacked immunity against it.
segments.turkishExplanation: Vücutları bu hastalıkla daha önce hiç karşılaşmamıştı, bu yüzden ona karşı hiçbir dirençleri yoktu.

segments.text: Most experts think this theory is unlikely on its own.
segments.englishExplanation: Most specialists consider this explanation improbable by itself.
segments.turkishExplanation: Uzmanların çoğu bu teorinin tek başına pek olası olmadığını düşünüyor.

segments.text: Still, it reminds us of something important.
segments.englishExplanation: Nevertheless, it brings an important fact to our attention.
segments.turkishExplanation: Yine de bize önemli bir şeyi hatırlatıyor.

segments.text: Sometimes a whole group of animals can be killed off by something too small to see.
segments.englishExplanation: Occasionally, an entire group of animals can be destroyed by microscopic organisms.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bazen bütün bir hayvan grubu, görülemeyecek kadar küçük bir şey yüzünden yok olabilir.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To completely destroy or eliminate a group or population.
learningPoints.exampleEn: The severe drought wiped out most of the crops.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Şiddetli kuraklık ekinlerin çoğunu tamamen yok etti.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To cause the death of all or a large number of a group.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir grubun veya türün tamamını veya büyük kısmını öldürüp yok etmek.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Extreme cold can kill off fragile plant species.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Aşırı soğuk, hassas bitki türlerinin kökünü kurutabilir.

quiz.question: It is possible that dinosaurs were ______ by a disease to which they had no resistance.
